title: Emergency Arrival Points on Coverage-Loss Discounts — Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
**Rule.** On a Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account whose coverage-terminated liability is being discounted, an account classified emergency that carries an emergency department level charge line (revenue code 0450) adds 5 percentage points to the coverage-loss discount percent; an account classified medically necessary that carries such a line adds 2.5 percentage points; any other account adds none.

| Service classification | Emergency department level charge line (0450) | Percentage points added |
|---|---|---|
| emergency | yes | 5 |
| medically necessary | yes | 2.5 |
| elective non-covered | yes | none |
| any | no | none |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- An emergency account with one emergency department level line and several laboratory lines adds 5 points.
- A medically necessary account that arrived through the emergency department, carrying one level line, adds 2.5 points.
- An emergency-classified account with no emergency department level line adds none.
